fusions.name: Spadework
fusions.desc: Digs the blade in for 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Landslide
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod of silt that deals 30 damage and bursts 3 tiles across, hitting everything near the target for 80% of the damage.

fusions.name: Sinkhole
fusions.desc: Digs a pit under the nearest enemy. It waits 2 minutes, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set off a blast that deals 24 damage around it.

fusions.name: Burrow Breath
fusions.desc: When your health runs low, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
